title: Direct Mirror composition versus AdapterFusion
hypothesis: Fusion of shared low-rank source adapters can occur in Mirror code space before adapter execution, preserving the linear case and reducing active compute, but nonlinear bottlenecks may prevent exact collapse.
physical_object: shared rank-6 input/output adapter factors with four logical source transforms and one shared fusion gate
mirror_coordinate: fifteen Givens angles per source transform; gate-weighted codes combine into an effective rank-space operator
logical_multiplicity: four source adapters composed into one effective adapter per input
controls: four independent rank-6 adapters with AdapterFusion output mixing
shared Mirror-coded source adapters executed separately
fixture: 32-dimensional input/output, rank 6, four source adapters, input-dependent softmax fusion gate; measure linear adapters and a tanh-bottleneck stress case

development.selection_metric: linear exactness max absolute error, nonlinear normalized MSE, actual serialized bytes, per-example MAC proxy and measured CPU latency

fresh.run_only_if: not applicable; deterministic algebraic screen with fixed seeds and no tuning

storage.format: torch.save payloads with all factors, source codes/matrices, and fusion gate
paid_objects: full adapter factors or shared factors
Mirror angles or generic coefficient matrices

compute.proxy: count per-example MACs for adapter paths, code fusion, and output projection; report angle-to-matrix setup work and resident reconstructed matrix bytes separately

success_gate: Both worlds: linear max abs error <=1e-6; payload <=0.75x full adapters; direct per-example compute <=0.60x shared AdapterFusion; nonlinear bottleneck NRMSE <=0.05.
failure_gate: Any broad replacement gate misses; report exact linear result separately.
boundaries: Deterministic low-rank algebra fixture; no learned quality or language claim.
The fusion gate is shared and identical across execution variants.
A broad PASS requires the nonlinear stress case; exactness for linear maps alone is scoped evidence.
